name: dclean-cli
description: Clean dev bloat: node_modules, Xcode, NVM, venvs. Moves items to Trash.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');for (const f of ['README.md','LICENSE']) { const t=p.join(__dirname,f); fs.rmSync(t,{force:true}); fs.copyFileSync(p.join(__dirname,'../../',f), t); }"

author: CodeLynther
